name: Sparrow Hop
summary: A phone tab bar with a little sparrow on a wire that hops to each tab you tap
about: A bottom tab bar for a bird-watching app where a house sparrow sits on a thin wire above the selected tab. Tap another tab and the sparrow turns, crouches and springs off, flaps across on an arc and lands with a squash, while the wire bounces under it, a few feathers drift down and the new page slides in from the side it is flying towards. Between hops it blinks, looks around, pecks and flicks its tail, and the inbox badge pops away once you have read it.
how: Tap or click a tab; the left and right arrow keys move along the bar and pick the next tab.
Watch the sparrow fly to the tab and the page slide in from that side.
Open Inbox to clear its badge; a new note arrives a little later.
The bar plays a short tour by itself until you tap, click or press a key.
